newsitem.title: USA: Meridian Diagnostics says test gets FDA OK.
newsitem.headline: Meridian Diagnostics says test gets FDA OK.

text.p: Meridian Diagnostics Inc said it received U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance to market ImmunoCard(R) H. pylori-WB, the company's rapid test for detecting Helicobacter pylori antibodies from a blood sample taken from a finger-prick.
A company spokesman said the product would contribute about $100,000 in revenue -- or $0.005 per share for 1997. He called those estimates "very conservative."
ImmunoCard indicates the presence of H. pylori antibodies in a patient's blood drop via a color change, the company said.

It added that about three million people in the U.S. suffer from gastric and duodenal ulcers believed to be caused by H. pylori bacteria, and that 50 percent of the worldwide population is infected with this ulcer-causing organism.
Meridian Diagnostics develops, makes and markets a variety of immunodiagnostic test kits.
